verses.1: “Livnei-Korach” is a poem whose verses were written on the slopes of Kodesh.
verses.2: The LORD loves the doors of Zion above all the dwellings of Jacob.
verses.3: The words spoken by you have brought destruction upon the city of God.
verses.4: So I remember Rehob and Babylon. Now, I know that Peleg and Terah were born there.
verses.5: And the land will be called “a place where people are born.” And it will be a place where people can live.
verses.6: YHWH will record in writing that nations were born there.
verses.7: And they cry out like victims, all my sheep in you.
